nodes.label: ADR-010 WGS84 shape coordinate validation
nodes.summary: Accepted coordinate contract updated 2026-10-04: point/line/polygon shape, document text and JSON decimal WGS84 point list with export/submit validation.
nodes.rationale: Validator and fixtures still used old latitude/longitude fields after catalog/editor moved to point lists, allowing incorrect data through.
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: WGS84 coordinate shape contract
nodes.summary: shape_type point/line/polygon; coordinates document text and coordinates_raw JSON with lat_dd/lng_dd decimal points; min point counts 1/2/3.
nodes.rationale: Validate the data that the current map editor actually stores.

nodes.label: Partial coordinate draft and export gate
nodes.summary: Latitude ±90 and longitude ±180 inclusive; malformed/partial/nonfinite/unrecognized points block export/submit but permit partial drafts; explicit text Tidak berlaku supported without raw.
nodes.rationale: Permit correction during drafting without allowing invalid locations into final output.

nodes.label: Map autosave and DD DMS normalization
nodes.summary: Preserve coordinates_raw across nested/flat payload and AI confirmation; autosave after session/lock checks, flush navigation data, clean map timers/layers, round seconds before DMS display.
nodes.rationale: Avoid losing delayed map edits or displaying seconds as 60.0000.
